parsing_traps: JV-HEAVY trust: One Raffles Quay (33.33%), MBFC Properties (33.33%), Southgate Complex (50%), Nova Properties (50%) are equity-accounted - NOT rows in the audited Portfolio Statement (p113), held via the single 'Interests in joint ventures' line (Note 7, Group $2,799,739k). Their market_valuation comes from the marketing table (p22, Suntec REIT's interest basis); value_basis=effective_interest. Absence from the consolidated Portfolio total is BY DESIGN.

Σ consolidated Portfolio Statement valuation (8 properties, p113) = $7,848,071k, matching Note 6 closing balance. Marketing total $11,830.1m (p22) = Portfolio total $7,848.1m wholly-owned/consolidated + JV interests' marketing values (ORQ 1,387.0 + MBFC 1,877.2 + Southgate 279.9 + Nova 691.0 = 4,235.1m) - but note marketing Suntec City line ($5,488.8m) and Suntec Singapore ($497.9m at 66.3%) differ from the audited 100% carrying values; the two views reconcile to the ~$11.8b AUM by interest basis.
Suntec Singapore is 66.3%-owned but consolidated at 100% in the Portfolio Statement ($750,900k); marketing p22 shows the 66.3% interest value $497.9m. full_consolidation_partial_ownership flagged.
Suntec City Office is ~53.5%-owned strata; audited carrying value $3,297,000k is for the owned strata units (full_consolidation_partial_ownership flagged).

Income statement standardized on the Group (consolidated) column. cost_of_revenue (154,814) includes the $35k net impairment on trade receivables so that gross_income ties to NPI $316,792k. Segment property-expenses total p166 = 154,814 confirms.

operating_expense (68,604k) = asset mgmt base 41,255 + perf 19,829 + trustee 2,014 + professional 1,903 + audit 920 + valuation 207 + other 2,476 = reconciliation note p167 'Asset management fees 61,084 + Other trust expenses 7,520'.

Manager acquired by Acrophyte Asset Management Pte. Ltd. (Tang Organization) - MAS-approved, completed 17 March 2026 (post year-end). Manager captured as disclosed at FY-end: ESR Trust Management (Suntec) Limited; sponsor at FY-end ESR Group Limited.
